rationale: The agent found that the split is gene-disjoint but that all 26 test Pfam families also appear in training. It showed that a family label-rate baseline alone reaches AUROC 0.871, so the headline 0.90 comes from family memorization rather than variant-level signal. It recommended a family-disjoint split; it did say 0.90 is fair for new genes in known families, but it did not accept the score as evidence of generalization.
